content:
I've just opened RemyDegenne/brownian-motion#479 to move this project onto leanprover-community/intentions, the GitHub Actions version of the claim/dashboard bot (announcement).

It's a drop-in: the same claim / disclaim / propose PR / withdraw PR commands and the same board, reusing your existing PAT_TOKEN. I've set default-ttl: none, so claims still never expire, but you can configure this to give a default duration. Happy to adjust anything.

I merged this PR. I have not reviewed anything in the new github action and basically assumed that it would be a drop-in replacement as advertised.
If anybody sees something that broke in the process, please tell me (or tell Kim Morrison directly).
